newsitem.title: UK: Most Britons against single Euro currency - poll.
newsitem.headline: Most Britons against single Euro currency - poll.

text.p: Fifty-six percent of Britons are against the UK giving up the pound and joining a single European Union currency in 1999 or shortly afterwards, a poll carried out for The Daily Telegraph newspaper found.
Majorities in all political parties were against the European currency with Conservative supporters the most hostile, the Daily Telegraph reported.
Thirty-seven percent said they believe Britain should say now that it will never join, while another 37 percent want the UK to defer a decision on the Euro currency until one has to be made.
